:::{#exm-mutual-information-identities-noisy-copy}
#### Mutual information identities with a noisy copy
<!-- no-figure: the example reports a handful of numbers, with nothing to plot -->

Take the fair coin $X$ and its noisy copy $Y$
from @exm-entropy-chain-rule-noisy-copy.
The chunk computes the [entropies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) from the joint [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) in [bits](#def-bit),
then the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) in four ways.

```{r}
#| code-fold: show
entropy <- function(p) -sum(p * log2(p))
joint <- matrix(
  data = c(0.4, 0.1, 0.1, 0.4),
  nrow = 2
)
h_xy <- entropy(joint)
h_x <- entropy(rowSums(joint))
h_y <- entropy(colSums(joint))
h_x_given_y <- h_xy - h_y
h_y_given_x <- h_xy - h_x
mi_definition <- h_x + h_y - h_xy
mi_reduction <- h_y - h_y_given_x
mi_conditionals <- h_xy - (h_x_given_y + h_y_given_x)
mi_twice <- ((h_x - h_x_given_y) + (h_y - h_y_given_x)) / 2
c(mi_definition, mi_reduction, mi_conditionals, mi_twice)
```

All four agree:
$\mutinfof{X}{Y} = `r round(mi_definition, 3)`$ bits
(@def-mutual-information, @thm-mutual-information-reduction, @thm-mutual-information-joint-minus-conditionals and @thm-twice-mutual-information).
Also $\entropyf{X} + \entropyf{Y} = `r round(h_x + h_y, 3)`$ bits
matches $\entropyf{X \mid Y} + 2 \, \mutinfof{X}{Y} + \entropyf{Y \mid X} = `r round(h_x_given_y + 2 * mi_definition + h_y_given_x, 3)`$ bits
(@thm-entropy-sum-decomposition).

:::
